title: Verifie enn konversasion antie
lede: Export enn sat WhatsApp ouswa Messenger ek met li. Nou lir li depi kumansman ziska lafin, ek marke bann moman ki kont.

upload.label: Met enn export sat
upload.hint: WhatsApp: ouver sat la, Export chat, Without media (.txt). Messenger: Download your information, enn konversasion, an JSON.
upload.invalid: Sa fisie la pa resanble enn export WhatsApp ouswa Messenger.
upload.empty: Nou pa finn trouv okenn mesaz dan sa export la.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.android: Android: ouver sat la, tap ⋮ → More → Export chat → Without media.
whatsapp.iphone: iPhone: ouver sat la, tap non kontak la → Export Chat → Without Media.

messenger.label: Messenger
messenger.steps: Meta Accounts Centre → Your information and permissions → Download your information → swazir konversasion la, format JSON.

who.title: Kikenn ou ete dan sa sat la?
who.hint: Zis mesaz lot dimoun la pou verifie; to bann la zis pou montre kontext.

header.truncated: Zis mesaz pli resan finn analize; sa export la pli long ki seki enn sel verifikasion kapav kouver.

story.title: Kouma listwar la finn sanze
story.empty: Pa finn detekte okenn etap dan sa konversasion la.

empty.title: Pankor ena konversasion sarze.
empty.body: Met enn export sat anho pou get analiz complet la.

errors.tooManyMessages: Sa export la ena plis ki {max} mesaz; zis {max} pli resan finn analize.
errors.network: Ena enn problem pou lir sa fisie la. Eseye ankor.

sourceNote: Zis text sa konversasion la ki finn retir bann kod identifian ek limite an longer ki avoy pou analiz; export la limem res lor sa laparey la.
